data.label:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
Write-Output '--- HEAD version stats ---'
$h = git -C D:\lean show HEAD:AUDIT_LEDGER.md
Write-Output ('HEAD_lines=' + ($h | Measure-Object).Count)
$tmp = 'D:\lean\tmp\_head_ledger.md'
git -C D:\lean show HEAD:AUDIT_LEDGER.md | Set-Content -Path $tmp -Encoding utf8
Write-Output ('HEAD_bytes=' + (Get-Item $tmp).Length)
Write-Output ('HEAD_has_S1942=' + ((Select-String -Path $tmp -Pattern 'S1942PrePsiFive' -SimpleMatch | Measure-Object).Count))
Write-Output ('HEAD_has_S1960=' + ((Select-String -Path $tmp -Pattern 'S1960' -SimpleMatch | Measure-Object).Count))
Write-Output ('HEAD_has_S1977=' + ((Select-String -Path $tmp -Pattern 'S1977' -SimpleMatch | Measure-Object).Count))
Write-Output '--- diff numstat for worktree ledger ---'
git -C D:\lean diff --numstat -- AUDIT_LEDGER.md
Write-Output '--- diff of last part (what I removed) : deleted-line signature ---'
git -C D:\lean diff -- AUDIT_LEDGER.md | Select-String -Pattern '^-## ' | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line }
